search.snippet: Jogre bones are bones dropped by jogres, which give 15 Prayer experience when buried. This can be increased by offering the bones in different ways: 45 XP when casting Sinister Offering. 45 XP when offered at the Sacred Bone Burner after the appropriate faith level has been achieved.

search.snippet: Jogres now have a 25% elemental weakness to earth spells. The NPC was graphically updated. Their name is a portmanteau of 'jungle ogre'. Before they were both graphically updated, jogres were simply a recoloured version of the ogres. Jogres are a type of ogre that live in the jungles of Karamja.
